lines: Pov: you're the Jester of every group chat
caption:
The Jester makes life lighter for everyone around them. That's a real strength.

The catch is that people get used to you being the fun one. So when you're not fine, nobody notices.

Who checks in on the funny friend in your group?

Comment ARCHETYPE and I'll send you the test 📩

#archetypes #jester #friendship
